dedupe_keys.name: quick risk estimation qre tool and climate qre undrr making cities resilient 2030

description: The Quick Risk Estimation tool helps cities identify and understand current and future risks, stresses and shocks and the exposure of human and physical assets to them. It is a structured multi-stakeholder process, with a narrower scope than a full risk assessment: taking account of measures already in place, participants score hazards and their impacts, and the tool produces a dashboard-style summary of the main risks and associated perils for a location or asset. Hazards follow the UNDRR classification and indicators are aligned with the Sendai Framework and the Sustainable Development Goals. It is published by UNDRR under the Making Cities Resilient 2030 initiative as a downloadable spreadsheet tool in several languages, free of charge, and a 2023 Climate QRE version integrates climate and disaster risks for cities and municipalities. Caveats: scores are qualitative expert judgements, results depend on who takes part, and it does not model hazards or cascades. It supports rapid scoping of critical infrastructure risks and priorities before quantitative resilience modelling; a related record is the Physical Vulnerability Database for critical infrastructure.
